summary: Tested BI module end-to-end (15 backend endpoints + frontend page). All 20 pytest tests passed. Frontend BI page loads cleanly, all 6 KPI cards populate with expected values (rutas=717, puntos=168,979, vel_max=158, anomalías=64), filters update charts, all 4 tabs render (dashboard area chart, heatmap, top-routes map+table, anomalies table+CSV export), histogram metric switcher works, granularity switcher works, device filter reduces totals correctly. No console errors, no page errors.

issues: Date inputs use native browser date picker (input type=date) instead of a shadcn Calendar component. Functional but inconsistent with shadcn UI pattern noted in guidelines.

critical_code_review_comments: BI module is well structured: router/analytics/data_loader split, lru_cache on data load, vectorized haversine, regex pattern validation on query params (good - returns 422 on invalid metric/granularity).
Optional UX improvement: replace native date inputs in /app/frontend/src/pages/BI.tsx with shadcn Calendar/Popover for consistency.
BI.tsx is ~580 lines - within acceptable range but could be split into Dashboard/Map/Routes/Anomalies sub-components if it grows.

Date filter test_kpis_filter_date returns 0/0 results because the test date range (2025-11-01..2025-11-30) seems to have no data in this dataset; test still passes with >=0 assertion but main agent may want to verify CSV date coverage matches the documented range 2025-10-07..2026-03-19.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_bi_endpoints.py. Run: cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_bi_endpoints.py -v. All BI endpoints under /api/bi/* validated. Note that /api/bi/route/{id} uses ruta_id 0..716 as integers. Heatmap min sample=100 (422 below), histogram metrics whitelist: distancia_km|duracion_min|vel_prom|velocidad. Frontend at /bi - all data-testids in problem statement are correctly wired.
